% Numeric probe only; it intentionally produces no diagram page.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{bending}
\begin{document}
\makeatletter
\pgfsetcurvilinearbeziercurve{\pgfpoint{0cm}{0cm}}{\pgfpoint{0cm}{3cm}}{\pgfpoint{3cm}{3cm}}{\pgfpoint{3cm}{0cm}}
\typeout{CURVILINEAR TABLE: \the\pgf@curvilinear@time@a;\the\pgf@curvilinear@length@a;\the\pgf@curvilinear@length@b;\the\pgf@curvilinear@length@c;\the\pgf@curvilinear@length@d}
\foreach \distance in {-1pt,1pt,3pt,10pt,3cm}{%
  \pgfcurvilineardistancetotime{\distance}%
  \typeout{CURVILINEAR distance=\distance;time=\the\pgf@x}%
  \typeout{CURVILINEAR FAR QUOTIENT: \meaning\pgf@curvilinear@quot@e}%
}
\makeatother
\end{document}
